name: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Na*ha -Another's 3rd Stage-
original_name: 魔法少女リリカルな○は -ANOTHER'S 3RD STAGE-
source:
In a town of regular people lived 3 different women. 
They possessed the ability to conjure magic... 

However two of them were on probation, and in the eyes of a hateful and jealous inspector this meant a restriction and stripping of power. 

Na**ha, F*te and Hay**e and their tragic suffering at the hands of the inspector! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE062216.html]DLsite English[/url]]
